name: Barbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and head, upper back and pelvis supported.
Grip the bar evenly, set the shoulder blades and unrack over the shoulders.
Lower to the lower chest with forearms near vertical.
Press up and slightly back to the starting position; rack securely after the set.
cues: Use rack safeties or an attentive spotter.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Lifting the pelvis off the pad.
breathing: Inhale and brace as the bar lowers; exhale during the press.
